# Oddlyyy : Full Studio Documentation & Capabilities

> Complete machine-readable overview of Oddlyyy: independent creative digital agency, capabilities, technical stack, verified projects, and engagement model.

## Identity & Positioning

- Name: Oddlyyy
- Legal Identity: Oddlyyy Creative Studio
- Positioning: Independent creative digital studio crafting distinctive brand systems, high-performance web platforms, and clever digital experiences.
- Tagline: "Be the exception."
- Operating Structure: Direct collaboration with the makers who design the brand and write the code. No account layers, no diluted messages.
- Contact: hello@oddlyyy.studio
- Official Staging URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/
- Official Target Production URL: https://oddly.com/

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Web Development & Digital Products
- Canonical URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/services/digital-platforms
- Summary: Bespoke business websites, dynamic digital platforms, and e-commerce applications built with Next.js, React, and modern edge infrastructure.
- Deliverables:
  - Custom Next.js web platforms with sub-second initial load.
  - Interactive product showcases and dynamic web applications.
  - Bespoke e-commerce systems with integrated checkouts.
  - Headless CMS integrations and content publishing workflows.
  - Accessibility compliance and mobile ergonomic optimization.

### 2. AI & Business Automation
- Canonical URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/services/ai-automation
- Summary: Intelligent AI solutions, automated workflows, and internal tooling that eliminate operational bottlenecks.
- Deliverables:
  - Custom internal AI agents and workflow automation.
  - Automated inquiry routing, lead qualification, and customer triage.
  - API bridges connecting CRM, databases, and third-party tools.
  - Knowledge retrieval systems and custom documentation chatbots.

### 3. Brand Identity & Creative Direction
- Canonical URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/services/brand-identity
- Summary: Visual identities, design systems, and creative direction for brands that refuse to blend in.
- Deliverables:
  - Core logo systems, marks, and responsive variations.
  - Custom typography selection and editorial pairings.
  - Color architectures with defined contrast ratios.
  - Comprehensive brand style guides and component tokens.

### 4. Content, Campaigns & Editorial Strategy
- Canonical URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/services/content-campaigns
- Summary: Compelling digital storytelling, creative campaigns, and high-impact visual content.
- Deliverables:
  - Campaign creative direction and visual concepts.
  - Interactive web launch activations.
  - Content roadmaps and storytelling assets.

### 5. Business Systems & Integrations
- Canonical URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/services/business-systems
- Summary: Custom web applications, API integrations, and centralized dashboards connecting fragmented business tools.
- Deliverables:
  - Custom internal dashboards and operational views.
  - Multi-service API integrations (Stripe, Razorpay, Airtable, CRMs).
  - Data pipelines and automated reporting utilities.

### 6. Mobile App Development
- Canonical URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/services/mobile-app-development
- Summary: Fluid mobile applications balancing intuitive design with robust engineering.
- Deliverables:
  - Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications.
  - Mobile design systems and micro-interactions.
  - Offline sync and real-time backend integrations.

### 7. The Odd Jobs
- Canonical URL: https://oddlyyy.vercel.app/services/the-odd-jobs
- Summary: Fast 1-to-2 week sprints for creative problem-solving, rapid prototyping, and unconventional digital installations.

## Verified Portfolio Projects

### 1. The Chess Project
- Slug: /work/the-chess-project
- Client: The Chess Project
- Industry: Chess Education / EdTech / Online Learning
- Implementation: Full-stack Next.js web application connecting students with FIDE-titled coaches. Features interactive course catalogs, LiveKit virtual classrooms, Bunny Stream CDN video delivery, and Razorpay checkout engine.

### 2. Meraki Designs
- Slug: /work/meraki-designs
- Client: Meraki Designs
- Industry: Architecture & Interior Design
- Implementation: Immersive architectural portfolio website featuring fluid editorial layout, responsive project galleries, and tactile spatial storytelling.

### 3. Chicago Yachts
- Slug: /work/chicago-yachts
- Client: Chicago Yachts
- Industry: Luxury Yacht Charters & Marine Hospitality
- Implementation: High-conversion charter booking platform with dynamic vessel showcases, route options, and direct inquiry booking flows.

### 4. Payzero Solar
- Slug: /work/payzero
- Client: Payzero
- Industry: CleanTech / Renewable Energy
- Implementation: Brand identity and interactive digital platform for solar savings education and commercial energy onboarding.

## Technical Standards

- Framework: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript (Strict Mode)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Animation: Framer Motion
- Typography Scale: Space Grotesk (Headings), DM Sans (Body), Caveat (Handwritten Accents)
- Performance Target: Sub-second first contentful paint, zero cumulative layout shift.
